pool.text: Portuguese navigator explored the area and the settlement was named after him.
A Portuguese fort was established on the site of the modern city.
A Portuguese fortress was completed around which the town developed.
A town grew around the fort starting around this year.
A commission was sent by the Portuguese government to drain marshy land.
Lourenço Marques was elevated to the status of town.
Trams have not been in use at all since this year.
The University of Lourenço Marques was opened.
The Universidade Eduardo Mondlane was established as the Universidade de Lourenço Marques.
The track was renovated and the surface changed to meet safety requirements.
The main port of Maputo handled seventeen million tons of cargo at its peak.
The city became the national capital upon Mozambican independence.
The city name was officially changed to Maputo in February.
Samora Machel renamed the hospital as Hospital Central de Maputo.
Television was introduced before which film and cinema had a prominent position.
The Birmingham based reggae group UB40 held a one-night-only concert.
The municipality of Maputo began a project to seriously consider rehabilitating infrastructure.
An international terminal was opened with a capacity for nine hundred thousand passengers.
The second phase of the rehabilitation project, PROMAPUTO2, began.
President Armando Guebuza announced that Vila Algarve would be restored.
